fieldDescription: [Master switch] for all Ramscoop fuel and supply generation.
Allows fuel generation in [nebulae] and [coronas]; the Nebula and Corona tabs can each turn their own fuel off.
Allows supply generation in [nebulae], and in [coronas] if enabled on the Corona tab.
Key that flips the [master switch] on the campaign map, until the game is loaded or these settings are saved. Unbound by default.

fieldDescription: Generate fuel while inside a [nebula].

fieldName: Fuel Rate (percent of max fuel per day)
fieldDescription: Fuel gained [per day] as a percentage of [max fuel]. Example: [4] with 500 max fuel = [20 fuel/day].
[Stops] generating once fuel on board reaches this percentage of [max fuel]. Example: [20] with 500 max fuel stops at [100]; 100 fills the tanks.
Also stops once fuel on board reaches this many [units]; the [lower cap wins]. Example: [300] stops at [300 fuel] however big the tanks are.
Stops this many units [below the cap] to leave room for salvaged fuel. Example: [50] with a cap of 100 stops at [50].
Which crew count toward supplies: [extra] = crew [above the fleet minimum]; [all] = all crew; [nocrew] = ignore crew and use the [No-Crew rate] below.
Supplies each counted crew member makes [per day] in the [extra] and [all] crew modes. Example: [0.1] with 200 counted crew = [20 supplies/day].
Rate used in [nocrew] mode: [percent] = percentage of cargo capacity per day; [flat] = fixed units per day.

fieldName: No-Crew Rate (percent of cargo per day)
fieldDescription: Daily supplies in [nocrew] + [percent] mode. Example: [10] with 1000 cargo = [100 supplies/day].
Daily supplies in [nocrew] + [flat] mode. Example: [10] = [10 supplies/day].
[Stops] generating once supplies on board (or all cargo, see below) reach this percentage of [cargo capacity]. Example: [20] with 1000 cargo stops at [200 supplies].

[Off]: the supply caps count [supplies only]. [On]: they count [everything in the hold], so supplies stop once the hold is that full. Example: [80] percent with 1000 cargo, 600 of it metals, stops at [200 supplies].
Also stops once supplies on board (or all cargo, as set above) reach this many [units]; the [lower cap wins]. Example: [300] stops at [300 supplies].
Generate fuel inside a [star corona]; where a corona overlaps a nebula this rate [replaces] the nebula rate.

fieldName: Fuel Rate (percent of max fuel per day)
fieldDescription: Fuel gained [per day] in a corona as a percentage of [max fuel]. Example: [25] with 500 max fuel = [125 fuel/day].
[On]: corona fuel stops at the [Nebula tab] caps. [Off]: it uses the [Corona caps] below.
Only with [Use Nebula Fuel Caps off]: stops once fuel on board reaches this percentage of [max fuel]. Example: [50] with 500 max fuel stops at [250].
Only with [Use Nebula Fuel Caps off]: also stops at this many [units]; the [lower cap wins]. Example: [300] stops at [300 fuel].
Only with [Use Nebula Fuel Caps off]: stops this many units [below the cap]. Example: [50] with a cap of 250 stops at [200].
Generate supplies in a [corona] using the [Nebula tab] supply settings and caps; where both overlap this [replaces] the nebula rate.
Corona supply rate relative to the [nebula supply rate]. Example: [200] = [twice] the nebula rate.
On [leaving] a nebula or corona, posts what was collected. Example: [Ramscoop collected +12 fuel and +30 supplies].
